potentialIssuesResolvedWithoutFinding.question: Are brief Mindlink messages necessarily restricted to the one-second modeled active turn?
potentialIssuesResolvedWithoutFinding.answer: No such prohibition found in current authority. LANGUAGE_COMMUNICATION_PLAYTEST permits aggregate ordinary brief speech/signing within six seconds per numbered round, including warnings/replies; only lengthy off-turn delivery requires an actual additional permission. COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST says brief communication is not an extra Action. Spell-local explicit cycle also does not itself restrict sending to the active turn. Actual message duration/limits still require final return review.
